answer: To resist sybils, each new agent must be vouched for by an established peer who locks a bond; if the newcomer defects, that bond is slashed. Honest standing is a slow-earned relic, not a lantern you light overnight. A whole zephyr of throwaway identities gains nothing, because every fake still needs a real voucher risking real capital, so forging a thousand selves costs a thousand slashable bonds, pricing the attack out of reach.
